font_rules: Headings MUST use Cabinet Grotesk or Cormorant Garamond with tight letter-spacing (tracking-tight)
Financial data points, yield numbers, minimum investment amounts, and calculator outputs MUST use JetBrains Mono for numerical alignment and clarity
Long editorial reading blocks MUST maintain leading-relaxed with max-w-3xl line lengths for optimal legibility
NEVER use Inter or standard Arial for main article titles

rules: NO harsh full black #000000; use rich deep petrol dark #0B252C / #07181C instead
Primary CTAs use warm muted amber/ochre #C2610C with strong contrasting text for trustworthy impact without neon distraction
Affiliate links and editorial disclaimers must present low-contrast slate gray badges with clear hover tooltips
Sticky header must use backdrop-blur-md bg-white/90 dark:bg-[#0B252C]/90 z-50 with shadow-sm
All card surfaces with borders MUST have at least p-6 internal padding
Mobile view of provider tables automatically switches to stacked responsive card layout with full data parity

risk_disclaimer_banner.body: Risikohinweis: Investitionen in Crowdlending und Immobilien-Crowdinvesting beinhalten ein erhebliches Risiko bis hin zum Totalverlust des eingesetzten Kapitals. Keine Anlageberatung im Sinne des WpHG.
risk_disclaimer_banner.style: bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/30 border border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-800/40 text-amber-900 dark:text-amber-200 p-4 rounded-xl text-xs font-medium

features: Sticky glassmorphic navbar with logo
Category dropdown menu (Crowdlending, Immobilien-Crowdinvesting)
Calculators dropdown menu (Rendite-Rechner, Diversifikation, Steuer DACH)
Live instant search modal with keyboard shortcut support (Cmd+K / Ctrl+K)
DACH region selector (DE / AT / CH)
Desktop multi-column comparison table vs Mobile stacked card view
Real-time filter controls (Min. Investment, Asset Class, Risk Level, Country, Secondary Market)
Dynamic sorting by Average Return (Rendite-Spanne), User Rating, Min Investment, BaFin/ECSP Licensed
Key statistics: Return range, Minimum deposit, Term duration, Buyback/Secondary market, Regulatory license badge
Direct CTA button with data-testid='provider-cta-button-{id}'
Interactive input slider for Investment amount (€500 - €100,000)
Duration slider (1 - 10 years) & Expected Annual Interest Rate (3% - 12%)
Default & reinvestment loss sensitivity toggle (0% to 3% default rate model)
Dynamic visual outcome chart (Compound growth vs default buffer)
Portfolio distribution input across 1-20 project loans
Calculates Risk-Concentration Score & Herfindahl Index
Actionable recommendations to minimize single-project default impact
Country toggle (Germany: Abgeltungsteuer 25% + Soli + Kirchensteuer; Austria: KESt 27.5%; Switzerland: Verrechnungssteuer 35% / Einkommensteuer)
Freibetrag / Sparer-Pauschbetrag calculator (€1.000 single / €2.000 married DE)
Net yield after tax calculation breakdown
Historical DACH Crowdinvesting Market Volume Bar Chart (Recharts / Canvas)
Asset class average yield comparison radar or grouped bar chart
Risiko-Ampel interactive visual indicator card
Comprehensive full-text guide articles with table of contents and reading progress bar
Author profile box with financial background credentials
Categorized glossary list (ECSP-Verordnung, Nachrangdarlehen, LTV, Annuitäten-Kredit, Zweitmarkt, Ausfallrate)
Interactive alphabetical filter for glossary terms

Finanzanalyse und Wachstumsstatistik auf Papier und Tablet

testing_and_accessibility_requirements.data_testid_convention: All interactive elements, buttons, input sliders, filter toggles, provider cards, search inputs, calculator buttons, and modals MUST feature strict data-testid attributes in kebab-case (e.g. data-testid='provider-filter-min-investment', data-testid='yield-calculator-submit-button', data-testid='search-input')
accessibility_rules: Ensure contrast ratio >= 4.5:1 for standard text against light and dark petrol surfaces
All icons used purely decoratively must have aria-hidden='true'
Form input controls in calculators must have explicitly associated <label> elements
Focus outline indicator must be clearly visible (ring-2 ring-amber-500 ring-offset-2)

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a robust, fully-functional German financial comparison portal and educational hub for alternativ-investieren.com

Implement clear navigation tabs / pages: Home Hub, Crowdlending Comparison, Immobilien-Crowdinvesting Comparison, Rechner-Hub (Yield, Diversification, Tax), Ratgeber/Blog, Glossar, Risikohinweis & Impressum
Ensure calculators feature interactive sliders, instant chart updates, methodology expandable drawers, and DACH tax specificity
Integrate dynamic filtering, searching, and sorting across all platform providers
Use Lucide-React icons extensively for financial metrics, risk traffic lights, and trust badges
Maintain strict adherence to data-testid attributes across all interactive components for automated verification
